title: Hachi-nan tte, Sore wa Nai deshou!
titleRomaji: Hachi-nan tte, Sore wa Nai deshou!
titleNative: 八男って、それはないでしょう！
synonyms: The 8th Son? Are You Kidding Me?
synopsis: Ichinomiya Shingo, a 25-year-old man working at a firm company, while thinking of tomorrow's busy working day, goes to sleep. However, when he woke up, he found himself in a room unknown to him and realized that he is inside a 6-years-old body, taking over his body and mind. He soon learns from the memories of the boy that the boy was born as the youngest child of a poor noble family living in a back country. Having no administrative skill, he can't do anything to manage the vast land his family has. Fortunately, he is blessed with a very rare talent, the talent of magic. Unfortunately, while his talent could bring prosperity to his family, in his situation it only brought disaster. This is the story of the boy, Wendelin Von Benno Baumeister, opening his own path in a harsh world.

In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

title: Akujo Kyousei Keikaku
synonyms: Villainess Correction Program, The Bad Girl Is Cute Today Too
synopsis: "Hey, Seraphina. When you grow up, don't kill me, okay?" The wizard Arvel meets his end at the hands of his fiancée, Seraphina, who would later become the emperor's mistress and a notorious villainess. However, when he comes to, he finds himself face-to-face with a young Seraphina! Astonishingly, he has returned to the body of his 13-year-old self. Seeing the young and still innocent Seraphina, Arvel decides he will help her become a proper lady and save his own life in the process. To start, he must find a way to prevent the death of his brother, Shou, who was once engaged to Seraphina. However, the situation is far from simple, as he must contend with Seraphina's neglectful family, other men vying for the beautiful Seraphina's attention, and a web of conflicting plots. Given a second chance, can Arvel alter Seraphina's fate and save her from becoming a villainess…!? (Source: Bushiroad, translated)
